topic: Gojo's 0.2 second Unlimited Void on platform B5F is the most underrated feat of the Shibuya Incident
title: Gojo's 0.2 Second Domain Was His Best Trick
description: Gojo's Unlimited Void lasted just 0.2 seconds in Shibuya, and it changed the whole fight. Here is why that tiny window is such a flex. Do you rate it above his later domain fights?
comment: Is Gojo's 0.2 second Unlimited Void his best feat in Shibuya, or is it overrated next to his fight with Sukuna?

lines.text: Gojo's Domain Expansion in Shibuya lasted just 0.2 seconds.

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer in a blindfold unleashing a starry void on a train station platform

lines.text: I think it's the most underrated flex in the whole series.

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer in a blindfold unleashing a starry void on a train station platform

lines.text: Platform B5F is packed with curses, and a train has just unloaded a crowd of transfigured humans.

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer in a blindfold unleashing a starry void on a train station platform

lines.text: Jogo's whole plan is that Gojo won't cut civilians down with his own hands.

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer in a blindfold unleashing a starry void on a train station platform

lines.text: So they push the hostages into the middle of the fight.

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer in a blindfold unleashing a starry void on a train station platform

lines.text: Gojo answers in a blink. Unlimited Void freezes every being on that platform. Chapter 89.

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer in a blindfold unleashing a starry void on a train station platform

lines.text: His cursed energy control lets him expand a domain for a split second, almost like a camera flash.

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer in a blindfold unleashing a starry void on a train station platform

lines.text: Then he needs only 299 seconds to wipe out every transfigured human on the platform.

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer in a blindfold unleashing a starry void on a train station platform

lines.text: Some fans say a domain that short barely matters. But it didn't need to last. It only needed to freeze them.

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer in a blindfold unleashing a starry void on a train station platform

lines.text: A feint built on hesitation just failed, completely.

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer in a blindfold unleashing a starry void on a train station platform

lines.text: So what could possibly stop a man who wins like that?

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer in a blindfold unleashing a starry void on a train station platform

lines.text: Because the number that matters here is this one.

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer in a blindfold unleashing a starry void on a train station platform
